_finding: simulate_buy and the B20 rules after the stress reviews (docs/b20-transfers-tz.md §4): the chain's pause decides on Base; every actor that moves the stock token is checked in its role, from the current reading or read at the head, else the line is venue_unchecked; a confirmed denial holds through an unrelated failure; the wallet read stands on its own; a wallet refused gets would_revert without a swap, one refused as sender no sell-back; the pause disagreement is said; the wallet is in no sentence and redacted from revert text.

mutations.name: paused on chain is not refused
mutations.expect: FAIL transfers paused on chain: refused

mutations.name: the issuer's list overrides the chain
mutations.find: const pauseFrom = chainPause === null ? current : { paused: [] }
mutations.expect: FAIL unpaused on chain, still paused on the issuer

mutations.name: the issuer's list is never the fallback
mutations.find: const pauseFrom = chainPause === null ? current : { paused: [] }
mutations.expect: FAIL no current chain answer: the issuer

mutations.name: a refused KyberSwap router is asked anyway
mutations.expect: FAIL the KyberSwap router refused as executor

mutations.name: an actor that could not be read counts as allowed
mutations.expect: FAIL ...and one that could not be read there

mutations.name: a refusal read at the head is ignored
mutations.find: return vs.includes(false) ? notAllowed(source) : vs.includes(null) ? unchecked(source) : line
mutations.expect: FAIL a quoted pool outside the checked ones

mutations.name: only the first delivering pool of a split route is checked
mutations.expect: FAIL a split KyberSwap route whose second delivering pool is refused

mutations.name: the v4 PoolManager is not checked
mutations.expect: FAIL a KyberSwap route through a v4 pool

mutations.name: a wallet refused as sender still gets a sell-back
mutations.find: : issuerPolicy && issuerPolicy.send === false ? Promise.resolve({ result: 'unknown', reason: 'wallet_not_allowed_by_issuer', source: C.primary, quotedAt: null })
mutations.expect: FAIL a wallet the sender policy refuses

mutations.name: the sell-back checks the buy pool
mutations.expect: FAIL the sell-back through another pool, that pool refused as a receiver

mutations.name: a refused wallet still runs the swap
mutations.expect: FAIL a wallet the receiver policy refuses: would_revert

mutations.name: the wallet read waits on the public reading
mutations.replace: const policyOfWallet = input.wallet && tr && transfers && transfers.reason !== 'read_failed'
mutations.expect: FAIL a failed reading never refuses either, and the wallet check stands on its own read

mutations.name: the wallet stays in the revert text
mutations.expect: FAIL a revert text that carries the wallet is redacted

mutations.name: a confirmed refusal from the reading is ignored
mutations.find: if (cached.every((v) => v === true || v === false)) return cached.includes(false) ? notAllowed(source) : line
mutations.replace: if (cached.every((v) => v === true || v === false) && !cached.includes(false)) return line
mutations.expect: FAIL a confirmed pool denial while another sub-call failed

mutations.name: only the uncovered actors are read again
mutations.find: const r = await inTime(rolesAt({ fetchImpl: f, urls: b20Urls, token: address, accounts: actors, now }), null)
mutations.replace: const r = await inTime(rolesAt({ fetchImpl: f, urls: b20Urls, token: address, accounts: actors.filter((a, i) => cached[i] !== true), now }), null)
mutations.expect: FAIL one actor of the line uncovered

mutations.name: an opaque delivering hop is not checked
mutations.expect: FAIL a delivering hop with an opaque pool id

mutations.name: the wallet read is not checked again at use
mutations.find: const walletCurrent = walletRule && Number.isFinite(walletRule.head_time) && now() - walletRule.head_time <= STALE_S * 1000
mutations.expect: FAIL a wallet refusal read before quotes that took past its freshness

mutations.name: the request's gate is shadowed again
mutations.find: const unchecked = (source) => ({ result: 'unknown', reason: 'venue_unchecked', source, quotedAt: null })
mutations.replace:
const unchecked = (source) => ({ result: 'unknown', reason: 'venue_unchecked', source, quotedAt: null })
    async function gate () {}
mutations.expect: FAIL after the answer has returned, no further call goes out
